primitives.name: Pressure-Split Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## System 1 — Pressure-split engine (EPA + INT) **Implements:** c02 finding #8 (pressure indices proposal — a01 verified); a03 V4 (veto boundary); a06 buildable spec; a02 naming contract.
primitives.assumptions: Pressure indices must be computable from available NFL data; clean/pressured splits are defined by presence of qb_hit and absence of post-season-only flags.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unbuildable due to lack of per-play pressure field in nflverse; Index 1 remains NULL until charted.

layer2.mapping: Maps QB behavior under pressure using floor-based EPA and INT metrics, validated via seasonal consistency checks.
layer2.telemetry: League-marginal pressure-floor rate reproduces across seasons within tolerance.

primitives.name: INT-by-Situation with EB Shrinkage
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## System 2 — INT-by-situation with EB shrinkage **Implements:** a03 INT recipe (display lane) + a06 buildable spec (engine lane); c02-r36 denoised-rate auditor method; occurrence-not-recovery rule.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'interception_occurrence': 'count per play', 'shrunken_rate': 'probability per play', 'M': 'regularization parameter (25)', 'n': 'sample size per cell'}
primitives.assumptions: Interceptions occur independently; recovery luck is purged via regression to league mean; estimation uses EB shrinkage with global hierarchy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Requires sufficient sample size (n ≥ 30) and proper hierarchical structure for shrinkage to apply.

layer2.mapping: Maps interception likelihood across situational contexts using shrinkage estimators and occurrence-only modeling.
layer2.telemetry: League-marginal INT rate reproduces the nflverse marginal on a holdout season.

primitives.name: Protection Stress Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Confounding note:** report `sensitivity_epa_floor` + `clean_epa_baseline` + `protection_stress` (System 1b) always — the QB's response, his baseline, and his protection context are a triple, never a lone number (S2, CH-PRESS-4).
primitives.assumptions: QB performance under pressure is measured relative to baseline; stress reflects deviation from expected outcomes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Computed independently from pressure-split engine; requires pfr_advstats loader for full implementation.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies QB vulnerability through the interplay of EPA response and protection context, forming part of a triadic analysis.
layer2.telemetry: Triple reporting ensures contextual integrity of QB behavior metrics.

reasoning_traces.think:
The pressure-split engine operates by isolating clean versus pressured dropbacks, computing EPA deltas and INT rates, while acknowledging that Index 1 cannot be built from current nflverse data due to missing per-play pressure fields. It uses a floor construction to maintain validity even when certain indices are uncomputable. The INT-by-situation system applies EB shrinkage to estimate interception probabilities across granular situational cells, purging recovery luck to avoid spurious correlations. Both systems rely on traceability to verified claims and enforce strict validation gates. The protection stress index complements these by providing a contextual lens on QB vulnerability, forming a triadic framework with EPA and baseline metrics. Failure modes include data incompleteness (e.g., post-season-only pressure flags) and misalignment between observed and modeled variables (e.g., biased clean-pressured contrasts).
